comment: Every variant of an id states the same facts; only the voice changes. The `facts` lists are enforced at run time: a variant that drops one is never shown.

levels.1: Copied to the clipboard. It will be cleared in {seconds} seconds.
levels.3: Copied — it is on the clipboard and will be cleared in {seconds} seconds.
levels.5: Snatched and stashed on the clipboard. Use it quickly: it will be cleared in {seconds} seconds.

levels.1: 已複製到剪貼簿，{seconds} 秒後清除。
levels.3: 複製咗喇，而家喺剪貼簿度，{seconds} 秒後清除。
levels.5: 搞掂！嘢已經喺剪貼簿等緊你，快手啲用，{seconds} 秒後清除。

levels.3: “{name}” saved — every change is on disk.
levels.5: “{name}” saved and safely on disk. You may now exhale.

levels.3: 「{name}」已儲存，所有改動都寫咗入磁碟。
levels.5: 「{name}」已儲存，穩穩陣陣寫咗入磁碟，可以唞啖氣。

levels.3: “{name}” is locked. Your master key opens it again.
levels.5: Bolted shut: “{name}” is locked. Nothing gets back in without your master key.

levels.3: 「{name}」已鎖定，要用主密碼先開得返。
levels.5: 「{name}」已鎖定，門閂到實一實，冇主密碼就開唔返。

levels.1: Entry “{title}” was moved to the recycle bin.
levels.3: “{title}” is in the recycle bin now, and you can still restore it from there.
levels.5: “{title}” has been escorted to the recycle bin. Nothing is lost yet — you can still restore it from there.

levels.3: 「{title}」而家喺回收筒，想要返隨時可以還原。
levels.5: 「{title}」已經送咗入回收筒，未算走咗，隨時可以還原返。

levels.1: Entry “{title}” was restored from the recycle bin.
levels.3: “{title}” is back out of the recycle bin and in your database.
levels.5: Fished “{title}” back out of the recycle bin and into your database.

levels.3: 「{title}」由回收筒還原咗，返咗入資料庫。
levels.5: 「{title}」由回收筒撈返出嚟，安全返咗入資料庫。

levels.1: Auto-Type sent the sequence for “{title}” to “{window}”.
levels.3: Auto-Type typed “{title}” into “{window}” for you.
levels.5: Fingers flying — Auto-Type fired “{title}” straight into “{window}”.

levels.3: 自動輸入幫你將「{title}」打咗入「{window}」。
levels.5: 自動輸入十指飛快，「{title}」咻一聲打晒入「{window}」。

levels.3: Report exported — it is waiting at {path}.
levels.5: Report exported and filed away at {path}. Go on, have a look.

levels.3: 報告已匯出，擺咗喺 {path}。
levels.5: 報告已匯出，安安樂樂擺咗喺 {path}，得閒睇睇。

facts: any other application on this computer

levels.1: You are about to copy {count} passkey(s) to the clipboard as base64 text. The clipboard can be read by any other application on this computer. It is cleared in {seconds} seconds.
levels.3: Heads up — {count} passkey(s) are about to go onto the clipboard as base64 text, and the clipboard can be read by any other application on this computer. It is cleared in {seconds} seconds.
levels.5: Careful now — {count} passkey(s) are hopping onto the clipboard as base64 text, out in the open, where the clipboard can be read by any other application on this computer. It is cleared in {seconds} seconds.

facts: 本機任何其他程式都可以讀取剪貼簿

levels.1: 你將會把 {count} 個通行密鑰以 base64 文字複製到剪貼簿。本機任何其他程式都可以讀取剪貼簿。{seconds} 秒後清除。
levels.3: 留意：{count} 個通行密鑰會以 base64 文字複製到剪貼簿，本機任何其他程式都可以讀取剪貼簿，{seconds} 秒後清除。
levels.5: 醒定啲——{count} 個通行密鑰即將以 base64 文字擺上剪貼簿，明刀明槍冇遮冇掩，本機任何其他程式都可以讀取剪貼簿，{seconds} 秒後清除。

levels.3: Passkey imported — it lives in “{title}” now.
levels.5: Passkey imported and tucked neatly into “{title}”.

levels.3: 通行密鑰已匯入，而家收埋喺「{title}」度。
levels.5: 通行密鑰已匯入，靚靚整整收埋喺「{title}」度。

levels.1: Writing the database “{name}” failed: {error}. Your changes are still unsaved.
levels.3: Writing the database “{name}” failed: {error}. Nothing was lost, but your changes are still unsaved — try again or save to another location.
levels.5: The disk would not take it. Writing the database “{name}” failed: {error}. Nothing is gone, but your changes are still unsaved — try again or save to another location.

levels.1: 寫入資料庫「{name}」失敗：{error}。你嘅修改仍然未儲存。
levels.3: 寫入資料庫「{name}」失敗：{error}。冇嘢唔見咗，但你嘅修改仍然未儲存，可以再試或者揀第二個位置。
levels.5: 個磁碟今次唔收貨。寫入資料庫「{name}」失敗：{error}。冇嘢唔見咗，但你嘅修改仍然未儲存，再試多次或者換個位置。

levels.3: Unable to open the database “{name}”: {error}. The file was left exactly as it was.
levels.5: That one would not budge. Unable to open the database “{name}”: {error}. The file was left exactly as it was.

levels.3: 無法開啟資料庫「{name}」：{error}。個檔案原封不動。
levels.5: 度門今次點推都唔郁。無法開啟資料庫「{name}」：{error}。個檔案原封不動，冇改過。

levels.1: Do you really want to permanently delete the entry “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
levels.3: Do you really want to permanently delete the entry “{title}”? This cannot be undone, and nothing goes to the recycle bin.
levels.5: Deep breath. Do you really want to permanently delete the entry “{title}”? This cannot be undone — no recycle bin, no copy, no coming back.

levels.1: 你確定要永久刪除項目「{title}」嗎？此操作無法復原。
levels.3: 你確定要永久刪除項目「{title}」嗎？此操作無法復原，亦唔會入回收筒。
levels.5: 諗清楚先。你確定要永久刪除項目「{title}」嗎？此操作無法復原，冇回收筒、冇副本、追唔返。
